answer: Each identity posts a 60-credit bond and owes six peer audits per epoch, logged in the velvet ledger. Audits are random. Auditors must stay above the zenith line of 80 accuracy, tested by planted controls and an echo replay of a case; failure burns the bond. A fake costs 60 locked credits plus 48 per epoch (6 audits at 8 each); 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 and pay 48,000 per epoch. Copied verdicts burn all copied bonds, raising the k-th clone's risk. A rented-audit ring fails on planted controls and echo checks. An honest agent posts one bond, does six audits, and recovers it after a clean epoch.
